segments.name: Security Solutions
segments.description: Delivers cybersecurity, cloud, identity, and secure messaging solutions that help government and commercial customers protect critical systems and manage cyber risk.
segments.evidence: The Security Solutions segment delivers cybersecurity, cloud, identity, and secure messaging solutions that help government and commercial customers protect critical systems, manage cyber risk, and operate securely in complex and regulated environments.

segments.name: Secure Networks
segments.description: Provides secure networking architectures, secure mobility solutions, and network management and defense services for defense and civilian missions.
segments.evidence: With a focus on enterprise security, the Secure Networks segment provides secure networking architectures and solutions to our customers through secure mobility solutions and network management and defense services.

revenueModel.text: Telos earns revenue primarily from prime contracts and subcontracts with the U.S. federal government, largely under firm-fixed-price, time-and-material, and cost-plus contract vehicles and task orders.
revenueModel.evidence: Our consolidated revenues are largely attributable to prime contracts or subcontracts with our contractors engaged in work for the U.S. federal government.
